title: system.unsupported
description: Emitted by QB when the user's request has no matching tool in the catalogue. mcpd echoes it back with the payload intact so the Controller can render a helpful CoT card without invoking PB. Never a lookalike (F-35).

requested_intent.description: The user's raw query (or QB's paraphrase). Displayed to the user in the UNSUPPORTED card.

suggestion.description: QB's suggestion — either a supported adjacent action, or a shell command the user could run manually. Displayed to the user.

alternative_actions.description: Optional list of catalogue action names QB thinks are adjacent to the user's request.
